content.title: WebAgents demo index
content.description: The agents of the WebAgents research prototype: a literature-review agent and a fictional airline's agent. Signed with a development key, for demonstrations only; every entry is metadata, and each package is verified when you open it.

entries.name: Literature Review Agent
entries.description: A constrained coordinator-worker literature review: searches Crossref, screens and reads candidate papers (and PDFs you pick), resolves citations and writes a related-work draft with verified quotes, and lists every paper it found with its screening verdict. With your leave it reads your research profile, keeps its own notes and proposes to remember the review. Its candidate deduplication runs as a WebAssembly module that can only compute.

entries.name: WebAir Travel Agent
entries.description: Talk to WebAir: search flights, ask about fares and rules, get a booking quote and simulate buying it, in one conversation through WebAir's own semantic API, using the travel profile you choose from your memory. Before a simulated purchase your browser asks you, with the quote's facts in front of you. Your browser checks WebAir's fare totals with a WebAssembly module that can only compute. WebAir is a fictional demo airline: nothing is ever booked or charged.
